Sales Order

The Sales Order view displays the complete details of a sales order document, providing a comprehensive overview of the order before it is converted to a sales invoice.

This view shows all essential order information including customer details, ordered items, quantities, unit prices, and totals. You can also see any applicable taxes, discounts, and the total amount due.

From this view, you can edit the sales order, email it to the customer, print it, or convert it to other transaction types such as a sales invoice when the order is ready to be fulfilled.

For more information, see: Sales Order — Edit
